leadText:
(Japanese: ポケモン4コマギャグ劇場 Pokémon 4Koma Gag Theater) is a Pokémon 4Koma created by 姫野かげまる Kagemaru Himeno. It was originally published in Bessatsu CoroCoro Comic Special from August 1997 to June 1999.

 
 

 

 

zh:宝可梦四格爆笑剧场
